title: gen_event: Decoupled Event Buses & Security Audit Loggers
solutionExplanation: Implements an isolated, dynamically attachable security audit event handler using gen_event to track failed logins and trigger brute-force alerts.

mentalModelCheck.question: What happens inside a gen_event manager process if an individual handler crashes with a runtime error during handle_event/2?

options.label: The event manager catches the exception, removes the faulty handler, and continues running normal event dispatch for all other attached handlers.
options.explanation: Correct! gen_event provides strict fault isolation: one broken handler module cannot crash the shared event bus.

options.label: The entire BEAM node reboots to restore memory consistency.
options.explanation: The BEAM node is completely unaffected.

options.label: The manager forwards the crash exception to every client in the cluster.
options.explanation: Exceptions are trapped locally by the gen_event process.
